def clean(df):
    d = df.copy()
    # normalize label variants (case / stray spaces)
    d['species'] = d['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.capitalize()
    d['island'] = d['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.capitalize()
    # numbers stored as text -> numeric
    for c in ['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        d[c] = pd.to_numeric(d[c], errors='coerce')
    # enforce allowed ranges: out-of-range values become missing
    d.loc[(d['bill_length_mm'] < 30) | (d['bill_length_mm'] > 60), 'bill_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    d.loc[(d['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (d['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    d.loc[(d['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (d['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # sex: only 'male'/'female' allowed; missing stays missing (do not guess)
    s = d['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    d['sex'] = s.where(s.isin(['male', 'female']))
    return d


def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    g = d.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
